check-rail-concept.png.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a finished, premium compact brand identity concept image for the desktop/Android Markdown task manager "Taskrail", direction A: CHECK RAIL.
Identity mode: requested rebrand. This is a NEW logo, replacing an old F logo. Preserve only the established deep forest green and warm ivory palette. Product: multiple separate project Markdown files, task checkboxes, completed task archival. Audience: people juggling personal projects. Personality: quiet, practical, precise, approachable.
The core mark fuses two parallel project paths with a completion check. Invent one refined, ownable geometric symbol: two substantial staggered rail-like paths move from the lower-left through a compact elbow and rise diagonally toward the upper-right, together resolving into a crisp check silhouette. A deliberate forest-green channel separates the parallel paths; optically balanced broad strokes and gently radiused corners. It must read instantly as a task/check/path symbol at small app-icon sizes, not a literal railway, a sports swoosh, mountains, or a generic double-tick messaging logo. No extra letters in the symbol. Flat vector-like geometry, completely uniform solid ivory fills, no internal paper folds or texture. Use at most two simple shapes.
Output a single landscape 4:3 presentation image, compact 2 by 2 grid with generous clear gutters, calm ivory outer canvas and deep-green panels. This is a focused APP ICON concept presentation, not a busy nine-panel moodboard.
Top left: dominant very large finished rounded-square app icon, forest green #173F35 field, ivory #F5F1E7 symbol, frontal and flat with generous inner safe space. Under it sparse neat wordmark "Taskrail" in a humanist sans-serif.
Top right: the identical symbol in green on ivory, generous whitespace, small unobtrusive label "A / CHECK RAIL".
Bottom left: same exact finished app icon shown at three progressively smaller sizes, clean centered row, no labels or numerical claims, demonstrating recognizability.
Bottom right: sparse credible warm-ivory desktop app header crop, identical icon next to "Taskrail", below only a short monospace Markdown task line "- [ ] Next step". This is a conceptual identity application, not an actual screenshot.
All panels MUST use the exact same mark shape and proportions, never reinterpret it. Editorial precision, generous margins, sparse copy, no gradients, no photorealistic materials, no bevel, no gloss, no dramatic shadows, no desk stationery, no decorative scenery. The main symbol must be the visual focus. Only text: "Taskrail", "A / CHECK RAIL", "- [ ] Next step".
check-rail-concept.png.refinement:
Edit this existing Taskrail direction A brand-board image. Preserve the 2x2 board arrangement, deep forest green and warm ivory palette, wordmark, all text and app-header mockup. Change ONLY the symbol geometry consistently in every instance, including large icon, reversed mark, all three small icons, and header icon.
Critical correction: the existing symbol looks like two upward stairs. It MUST instead form a clear CHECKMARK silhouette. The stroke trajectory starts at the upper-left, travels diagonally DOWN and right into a low central elbow, then travels diagonally UP and right into a long rising terminal. There must be NO horizontal section in this mark. Think a wide, compact asymmetric V: short descending left arm, long ascending right arm. Build this single check silhouette out of two substantial parallel bands following that same down-then-up course with a clean narrow green gap. Two close parallel project rails form ONE integrated tick, NOT two disconnected separate checkmarks. The lowest elbow must sit well BELOW the starting endpoint at the left, so the tick reads unmistakably. Keep it broad, compact, centered with ample padding, gently radiused edges and optically balanced terminals. Flat vector-like solid colors, sharp contours, no new details or textures.
The SAME corrected check/rail geometry must repeat exactly across every application. Leave the title "A / CHECK RAIL", "Taskrail", and "- [ ] Next step" unchanged.
